items: prefix added to verbs of motion: about, around — обо- + -йти́ (“to go”) → обойти́ (“to go around”)
prefix added to nouns: close by, around — о- + край (“land, country”) + -ина → окра́ина (“outskirts, periphery”); о- + бок (“side”) + -ина → обо́чина (“roadside, curb”)
prefix added to verbs: completely, to the full extent
prefix added to adjectives or nouns to produce factitive verbs in conjunction with -ить, i.e. verbs with the meaning of making (someone or something) the mentioned characteristic or property

prefix added to adjectives or nouns to produce fientive verbs in conjunction with -ить + -ся or with -еть, i.e. verbs with the meaning of becoming or receiving the mentioned characteristic or property — о- + зо́лото (“gold”) + -и́ть + -ся → озолоти́ться (“to receive gold; (figuratively) to get rich”); о- + зелёный (“green”) + -ить + -ся → озелени́ться (“to become green; to become planted”); о- + безлю́дный (“uninhabited, depopulated”) + -еть → обезлю́деть (“to become depopulated”)
